Multiple Fatal Road Accidents Reported Across India

Multiple fatal road accidents have been reported across India. In Rajasthan, a woman and her two sons were killed when a trailer ran over them. In Tamil Nadu's Tiruchirappalli, a van collided with a tree, resulting in five deaths. Another incident in Tamil Nadu's Tiruchirappalli involved a car ramming into a tree, which led to eight fatalities and two injuries. The Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu expressed grief over the incident.
